subject.title: fix(feishu): preserve inbound messages across restarts

question: Should Feishu adopt the shared durable ingress drain in this PR after a real restart/recovery proof, or should this migration be sequenced through a separately approved channel rollout?
rationale: The branch changes channel durability and persistent replay settlement across several Feishu entry points, while the related rollout issue does not establish this channel’s approval or release sequencing.

options.title: Require live recovery proof and continue review
options.body: Keep the shared-drain implementation in scope, but require a redacted Feishu receive/restart/recovery transcript or recording that demonstrates exactly-once adoption before merge.

options.title: Sequence Feishu separately
options.body: Pause this PR and decide Feishu’s migration order and acceptance criteria in the broader channel-ingress rollout before accepting the durable-state change.

recommendation.title: Require live recovery proof and continue review
recommendation.body: Keep the shared-drain implementation in scope, but require a redacted Feishu receive/restart/recovery transcript or recording that demonstrates exactly-once adoption before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor authored the supplied implementation commits and can provide the missing Feishu behavior evidence while a channel owner confirms direction.
